SUP E R DU T Y L IK E NO O T HE R
This beast is something special. “What a workhorse,” says Motor Trend. Its name – stamped front and center. And
Super Duty only gets tougher from there. This year, a new F-450 Regular Cab 4x2 hits the ground towing a best-in-class1
35,000 lbs.2 A new LARIAT Sport Package3 on 4x4 Crew Cab models delivers your gear to the trailhead in style with
blacked-out exterior trim and black-painted aluminum wheels.
Inside, a new specially tuned, 1,000-watt B&O PLAY™ Premium Audio System by HARMAN4 gets the cabin rocking like
never before. While a new FordPass™ Connect 4G LTE Wi-Fi hotspot4,5 lets you – and the crew – connect up to 10 devices.
As America’s best-selling truck for 41 years, Ford F-Series helps you finish jobs others won’t even start. From F-250
to F-450, in work-ready XL to fully loaded LIMITED, this truck’s work ethic is legendary. The 2019 Ford Super Duty.
Rock solid. Ready for duty.
2019 Super Duty® | ford.com
F-250 LARIAT Crew Cab 4x4. Magnetic. Available equipment. 1Class is Full-Size Pickups over 8,500 lbs. GVWR based on Ford segmentation. 2When properly configured. See Towing chart in Specifications for maximum ratings
by configuration. 3Available Fall 2018. 4Available feature. 5Certain restrictions, 3rd-party terms, or message and data rates may apply. See footnotes 6 and 7 on XL Features pages and your Ford Dealer for details.
Vehicles throughout this publication may be shown with optional and aftermarket upfit equipment and without standard antenna.

AXLES ARE STRONG and capable.
Ratios range from 3.31 to 4.30. Choices
include non-limited-slip, limited-slip
and electronic-locking.1 Gear and bearing
designs are engineered and optimized
by weight for the extreme capability of
the 2019 Super Duty.
DRIVESHAFTS, TRANSFER CASES
AND U-JOINTS are engineered to handle
the monstrous torque output of both
Super Duty engines. In the 4WD transfer
case, an electro-magnetic clutch provides
smooth and immediate shift-on-the-fly
capability in conditions where additional
traction is needed.
LARGE 2.5" AND X-LARGE 3" TRAILER
HITCHES are built right into the frame,
extending so far underneath (and using
so much high-strength steel) that
weight-equalizing bars aren’t needed –
saving time and effort when hooking
up a trailer. On many configurations,
hitches are weight-carrying2 up to the
max. tow ratings.
Until the job site is poured and screeded, you rely on Super Duty to get your heavy
equipment and tools through mud, sand, snow and difficult terrain. Thankfully, on
4x4 models with electronic shift-on-the-fly, engaging 4WD is as simple as setting the
proven manual-locking front hubs to AUTO and turning a dial on the instrument panel.
In the 2019 Ford Super Duty, you’re well-prepared to conquer the toughest terrain.
FX4 OFF-ROAD PACKAGE. Increase your off-road capability by adding transfer case and fuel tank skid
plates, Hill Descent Control,™ and off-road-tuned shocks that help get you ready for serious, low-speed
crawling. An electronic-locking rear differential1 (SRW models) uses a true mechanical dog-clutch mechanism
to lock the rear axle shafts together so they turn at the same speed for maximum gripping power.
AVAILABLE: ALL TRIMS
2019 Super Duty® | ford.com
1Available feature. 2When properly equipped on select models. See Towing chart in the Specifications section for ratings by configuration.

SUP E R DU T Y C A PA BIL I T Y
There’s capability. And then there’s Super Duty capability. Our owners expect the best. The 2019 Ford
Super Duty delivers. On multiple levels. Need to tow more than 17 tons? You’ll be driving a Super Duty. If your
conventional towing needs approach 21,000 lbs., that’s Super Duty as well. Want to haul more than anyone
else? Then load up the cargo box of a Super Duty. Get the picture? No matter what limit you need to test,
you’ll find your answer in an F-250, F-350 or F-450 Ford Super Duty.

New Vehicle Limited Warranty. We want your Ford F-Series Super Duty® ownership experience to be the
best it can be. Under this warranty, your new vehicle comes with 3-year/36,000-mile bumper-to-bumper
coverage, 5-year/60,000-mile Powertrain Warranty coverage, 5-year/60,000-mile safety restraint
coverage, and 5-year/unlimited-mile corrosion (perforation) coverage on aluminum body panels – all with
no deductible. The Ford 6.7L Power Stroke® diesel engine gets 5-year/100,000-mile warranty coverage.
Please ask your Ford Dealer for a copy of this limited warranty.
Roadside Assistance. Covers your vehicle for 5 years or 60,000 miles, so you have the security of knowing
that help may be only a phone call away should you run out of fuel, lock yourself out of the vehicle or need
towing. Your Ford Dealer can provide complete details on all of these advantages.
Ford Credit. Get the ride you want. Whether you plan to lease or finance, you’ll find the choices that are
right for you at Ford Credit. Ask your Ford Dealer for details or check us out at fordcredit.com.
Ford Protect™ Extended Service Plans. Whether you purchase or lease your Ford vehicle, insist on
genuine Ford Protect extended service plans. Ford Protect has a variety of plans to give you peace-of-mind
protection whether you want vehicle component or maintenance coverage. Plus, they are fully backed by
Ford and honored at all Ford dealerships in the U.S., Canada and Mexico. When you visit your dealer,
insist on genuine Ford Protect extended service plans.
Insurance Services. Get Ford Motor Company quality in your auto insurance. Our program offers
industry-leading benefits and competitive rates. Call 1-877-367-3847, or visit us at fordvip.com for
a no-obligation quote. Insurance offered by American Road Services Company (in CA, American Road
Insurance Agency), a licensed agency and subsidiary of Ford Motor Company.
Ford Original Accessories. They’re warranted for whichever provides you the greatest benefit: 24 months/ F-250 XLT with XLT Value Package in Oxford White accessorized with 5" black step bars, hood deflector, side window deflectors,1
hard-folding tonneau cover,1 heavy-duty splash guards, chrome front tow hooks, LED fog lamps,1 and rear wheel-well liners
unlimited mileage, or the remainder of your Bumper-to-Bumper 3-year/36,000-mile New Vehicle Limited
Warranty. Ford Licensed Accessories (FLA) are warranted by the accessory manufacturer’s warranty.
FLA are designed and developed by the accessory manufacturer and have not been designed or tested
to Ford Motor Company engineering requirements. Contact your Ford Dealer for details and/or a copy
of all limited warranties.
